description: List the articles (Artikel) of the document in their order – they define the reading order of a tagged PDF when use_for_tagged_pdf is true: articles[] {name, index, export, members[] {frame_id, kind, class_name, page, on_parent, story_id}, member_count}, count and use_for_tagged_pdf (Für Lesereihenfolge im getaggten PDF verwenden). A text frame brings its whole story, anchored objects follow their text. include_uncovered true adds uncovered[] {frame_id, kind, page}: text frames, image frames and groups on document pages that are in no article and no artifact (capped at 500, uncovered_total). Read-only.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

include_uncovered.description: Also list content outside every article. Default false.

name: list_articles
title: List articles (reading order)
